faqs.question: How do I reserve a room?
faqs.answer: Send an inquiry with your check-in and check-out dates, room preference, and guest count. The reservations team will confirm availability, the final rate, inclusions, and payment instructions. An inquiry does not reserve a room.

faqs.question: Where is the hotel located?
faqs.answer: Find us on M. Roxas Street in Barangay Sto. Niño, Calapan City, near Xentro Mall and behind Landbank Calapan. Open our Google Maps directions for the route from your starting point.

faqs.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
faqs.answer: Please confirm the current times with reservations. Tell the team if you need early arrival or late departure; availability and charges may apply.

faqs.question: Is pool access included with my stay?
faqs.answer: Pool access, guest limits, outside-visitor rates, and schedules depend on your confirmed offer. Ask before visiting. Children require responsible adult supervision, and weather or maintenance may affect access.

faqs.question: Can you arrange an event with accommodation?
faqs.answer: Yes, ask about coordinating your venue, dining, and a block of guest rooms. The team will confirm the available layouts, capacity, menus, equipment, and current package terms.

faqs.question: Can you help with accessibility or special requirements?
faqs.answer: Contact the team before booking to confirm step-free access, room and bathroom arrangements, dietary requirements, transport assistance, or other needs.

faqs.question: What if something in my room needs attention?
faqs.answer: Contact reception promptly with the room number and issue so the team can assist. Ask before booking if reliable hot water or a particular amenity is essential to your stay.

policies.title: Booking & cancellations
policies.body: A reservation is confirmed only after the hotel issues a written confirmation and the required payment terms are met. Ask for current check-in, check-out, deposit, cancellation, no-show, children, extra-bed, tax, and refund terms before paying.

policies.title: Pool & wellness
policies.body: Confirm hours, age restrictions, admission fees, staying-guest inclusions, and outside-guest access before visiting. Children must be supervised by a responsible adult. Follow posted safety instructions; weather and maintenance may close facilities. Contact reception for on-site assistance or call 911 in an emergency. Ask staff about any health or accessibility requirements before using wellness facilities.

policies.title: Events & outside suppliers
policies.body: Your written event agreement must confirm venue capacity, layout, guest count, deposits, cancellation, overtime, catering, outside suppliers, setup and teardown, equipment, damage responsibility, and accommodation blocks. Do not assume any package inclusion before receiving a proposal.

policies.title: Privacy & your information
policies.body: When you send an inquiry, we use your contact and planning information to respond and arrange the requested service. Newsletter consent is separate and optional. Submitted details are stored privately and may be processed by our email delivery provider. We do not sell your details. Request access, correction, or deletion through filipinianahotel@yahoo.com. Inquiry records are scheduled for deletion after 90 days unless needed for an active booking or legal obligation. Newsletter recipients can unsubscribe using the link in their confirmation or any future campaign.
